# Contract: characters (v1.2)

Producer: ENV C (generated humanoids + animations). Consumer: ENV A (NPC/crew prefabs).
Until delivered, ENV A uses capsule placeholders with the same node names.

## Rig
* One shared humanoid skeleton `rig_humanoid` (generated by `tools/blender/characters/rig.py`),
  height 1.78 m (default), Y-up, facing −Z, root at the feet. Bones (exact names):
  `root, hips, spine, chest, neck, head, clavicle.L/R, upper_arm.L/R, forearm.L/R, hand.L/R,
  thigh.L/R, shin.L/R, foot.L/R, toe.L/R` plus finger chains `thumb|index|middle|ring|pinky_0[1-3].L/R`.
* Body variants are produced by scaling bones within ±6% height and through shape keys
  (build, gender, age); all of them share the skeleton so animations retarget 1:1.

## Visual scene shape (`world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn`)
```
<Root> Node3D
├── Skeleton3D (rig_humanoid) with MeshInstance3D parts (body, head, outfit, gear)
├── AnimationPlayer with library "humanoid" (names below)
├── Marker attachments as BoneAttachment3D: `HandR` (weapon), `HandL`, `Head` (mask/hat), `Back` (bag),
│   `Hip` (pager/radio)
└── Hitbox proxies are NOT here (ENV A builds hitboxes from bone names)
```
Specials add: Wrecker `Faceplate`, `Visor` MeshInstance3D nodes (A hides them on break) and
`HeadArmored` variants; Phantom `Goggles` with emission; Bulwark `Shield` scene (separate, with
`Collision`); Longshot `LaserOrigin`.

## Animation names (library "humanoid"), in-place, 30 fps, loops marked *
`idle*, idle_alert*, walk*, run*, sprint*, crouch_idle*, crouch_walk*, strafe_l*, strafe_r*,
walk_back*, turn_l, turn_r, aim_rifle*, aim_pistol*, fire_rifle, fire_pistol, reload_rifle,
reload_pistol, melee, death_front, death_back, hit_react, surrender, kneel_cuffed*, hands_up*,
cower*, lie_down*, tied*, flee*, phone_call*, radio_call, pager_answer*, investigate_look*,
smoke*, lean_wall*, sit_chair*, desk_type*, browse*, downed*, tased*, kick_charge, kick_hit,
shield_walk*, shield_bang, heal_ally, dozer_walk*, climb_ladder*, carry_bag_walk*, throw_bag,
interact_low*, interact_mid*, interact_high*, drill_place`
First-person viewmodel arms: separate rig `rig_arms` (C) plus animation sets per `WeaponDef.anim_set`
(B requests new sets via the lead).

## v1.1 clarifications (QD-2, D-029)
* Producer: **ENV D** (D-027), no longer ENV C.
* Exact node paths in `world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn`: `<Root>/Skeleton3D` (node name literally
  `Skeleton3D`), `<Root>/AnimationPlayer`, and BoneAttachment3D nodes `HandR`, `HandL`, `Head`, `Back`, `Hip` as
  children of `Skeleton3D`. Clips are played as `"humanoid/<clip>"`. The library comes from a single shared
  `char_anim_humanoid` glb, converted to an AnimationLibrary resource by ENV D's assembly tool.
* Masks: `game/assets/masks/mask_<name>.glb`. The MaskDef.model scene has its pivot at the face centre and −Z forward, and
  attaches to `Head`.

## v1.2 (QD-3, QB-51, D-038)
* Each BoneAttachment3D (`HandR`, `HandL`, `Head`, `Back`, `Hip`) has a child `Marker3D` named **`Socket`**
  carrying the attach offset, because a BoneAttachment3D's own transform is overwritten by the bone. Attach to
  `<Marker>/Socket`: the weapon at `HandR/Socket` (weapon X right, Y up, −Z muzzle), the mask at `Head/Socket` (face
  centre; MaskDef pivot seats there), loot bags at `Back/Socket`, and the pager/radio at `Hip/Socket`.
* Masks: ENV A attaches masks with ENV B's `MaskCatalog.resolve()/from_descriptor()` + `MaskComposer.instantiate()`
  (by class name). ENV A never builds mask visuals itself.
* Assembled character scenes keep their skinned meshes as binary `.res` beside the scene (~1.2 MB each,
  accepted; repo size watched per D-011).
* `world/characters/characters.json` is the index of assembled characters (id → scene path).
